world_comm.description: Native MPE Simple World Comm: four pursuers, two foragers, food, obstacle and forests. Leader broadcasts a four-channel target-position code.

smax.description: Native SMAX 3m: three marines against three heuristic enemies. Upstream observation-based heuristic versus random valid ally actions. Frames are decision-step snapshots, not interpolated combat ticks.

overcooked_v2.description: Native OvercookedV2 cramped_room_v2 (contextual kitchen rendering and original renderer screenshots): two chefs, multiple ingredients, recipe indicator, cooking and delivery. Full-state scripted task planner versus random actions. This illustration does not test decentralized partial-observation learning.
overcooked_v2.policy_access: privileged full simulator state for scripted kitchen planner

jaxnav.description: Native JaxNav BlankCross2: differential-drive robots crossing toward opposing goals. Local goal-bearing controller with LiDAR braking versus random actions.
jaxnav.policy_access: local goal bearing, range and LiDAR observations

scope: visual demonstrations, not CORA integration or learned baselines
